title: Oh My, Meteors! MWR Compat Datapack
description: A datapack to make Oh My, Meteors! Work better with the MWR Modpack.
body: This datapack is mainly for use in the MWR Modpack, but feel free to use it in whatever pack you like. This datapack adds Osmium to Oh My, Meteors! meteors, and Applied Energistic 2 items to one meteor.
